summary: Frontend-only testing for iter51 (Profile / Team / Forgot-password / Sidebar gating). All five feature groups passed end-to-end against the public preview URL with admin@hesab.app / admin123 plus a freshly-seeded viewer account. Forgot-password full flow (lookup question → wrong answer rejected → correct answer resets → re-login with new password) succeeded; admin password was restored to admin123 at the end of the run.
action_items: Optional perf: TeamManagement renders all 4499 user rows in a single table without virtualization/pagination — page is usable but DOM is heavy. Consider server-side search + pagination or a virtualized list (react-window) for future iterations.

Optional: 'logout-btn' in the sidebar is overlapped by the 'Made with Emergent' badge anchor in the bottom-right; in Playwright the click is intercepted unless force=True is used. Real users on production also have this badge — consider raising z-index of the sidebar footer above the badge, or adding bottom padding so the badge doesn't sit on top of the logout button on lower viewports.

Optional: After the forgot-password 'reset done' step, the modal does not clear the underlying login form fields and on close it leaves the user on the login screen — UX is fine, just noting that auto-filling email could be a nice extra.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamManagement.jsx loads /team/users + /auth/permissions/catalogue with Promise.all and renders the full table client-side. Works correctly but 4499 rows in DOM at once is a perf/scroll smell — add pagination or virtualization.
ForgotPasswordModal.jsx correctly disables answer/new-pwd/confirm inputs and submit button when has_question=false — good defensive UX.
Profile.jsx password / email / security-question forms all use bearer cookie+JWT correctly; toasts reflect backend errors verbatim (e.g., 'كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة').
test_credentials: Owner: admin@hesab.app / admin123 — restored at end of run. Admin security question is set to 'ما هو لون سيارتك المفضل؟' with answer 'أحمر' (added during testing — kept active so next runs can re-exercise forgot-password flow).
seed_data_creation: Created one viewer user via the UI: test_viewer_3401@hesab.app / viewerpass123 (kept for re-testing non-owner gating). One accountant test user (test_acc_3261@hesab.app) was created and then deleted as part of the delete-flow test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin sec-question is now set ('ما هو لون سيارتك المفضل؟' / answer: 'أحمر'). A non-owner viewer account 'test_viewer_3401@hesab.app' / 'viewerpass123' is available for negative-permission tests. Team list is ~4500 rows; always locate users via [data-testid=team-user-row-{id}] or DOM evaluate filtering on email cell rather than by index.
